request.description: Cozy whimsical fantasy inn game, crisp hand-placed-looking pixel art, readable chunky shapes, limited muted moss green and warm brown palette, restrained shading, no text, no interface, no blur. One short wide rectangular two-pane window mounted in the rear wall of a cozy forest inn, seen straight on from a slightly raised top-down RPG camera. Simple chestnut wooden sash, muted deep slate-teal panes, just a few silver blue rain streaks and a narrow oak sill. Dark trim, clean compact shape, no curtains, flowers, scenery, plaster wall or outdoor scene. Window only on transparent background with padding all around.
